reply:
Plain `git stash` only stashes tracked changes. Untracked files stay in the working tree unless you pass `-u` or `-a`.

That explains your symptom: the new file was untracked, so `git stash` left it there. You need `git stash -u` to include untracked files, or `git stash -a` to include both untracked and ignored files.
